summary.description: Health-armed two-second native V3 floor-load measurement with current raw LiDAR clearance, full L1-L12 capture and bounded shutdown.
goals: fresh zero-output encoder, BNO055, LiDAR and L3 preflight in the same Hub session
current raw LiDAR front-sector clearance of at least 0.70 m before health arming
exactly 100 resident ticks at 0.15 m/s nominal straight speed (2.0 s at 20 ms)
immediate signal stop on raw LiDAR, encoder, L3 displacement, yaw or elapsed-time bound
complete per-tick L1-L12, control, actuation, GPIO/PWM and de-duplicated raw-scan capture
post-active IDLE, SIGTERM SHUTDOWN and verified four-pin hard-low after close
